fragment_policy.generated_ids: ol-{readable semantic tuple}--{first 12 hex digits of SHA-256 of the tuple}
fragment_policy.profile_parity: a semantic object keeps the same fragment ID in every chapter profile where it appears
fragment_policy.source_labels: preserve a unique literal source label; apply an adjudicated sidecar-derived literal ID when required

relative_link_policy: all core navigation and assets use package-relative URLs with no base element
reserved_route_policy: reserved chapter routes are data, not anchors, until their tranche is integrated; no broken links are emitted
